        class Dataset(torch.utils.data.Dataset):
            def __init__(self, img_dir, transform, id_list, label_map):
                self.img_dir = img_dir
                self.transform = transform
                self.id_list = id_list
                self.label_map = label_map

            def __len__(self):
                return len(self.id_list)

            def __getitem__(self, idx):
                img_name = self.id_list[idx]
                full_path = os.path.join(img_dir, img_name)
                image = Image.open(full_path).convert("RGB")
                image = self.transform(image)
                if self.label_map is not None and isinstance(self.label_map, dict):
                    labels = self.label_map.get(img_name)
                    if labels is not None:
                        target = labels
                    else:
                        target = 0
                else:
                    target = 0
                return image, torch.tensor(target, dtype=torch.long)

    except Exception as e:
